name: Phantom Mansion II: Treasures of the Seven Seas - The North Sea
summary: Avast! Hector is still trolling the Seven Seas! Now, he be in the frozen North Sea. Hector searches for treasure in an icy cave. Using the arrow keys, you must guide Hector from room to room, solving the puzzles in each room to get the golden treasure skulls. Avoid ghosts and other nasty creatures. Avoid stepping into unfrozen water. Hector cannot swim and will drown. Be careful on icy as hector will slide until he lands onto solid ground. If you encounter a locked door, somewhere within the room will be a matching key. Switches can also be used to open walls.
